'''Embezzlement''' was a part of the [[Material Procedures]] branch of [[Situational Enforcement/Legends|Situational Enforcement]], which was a division of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] [[Security Division]]. It had the highest efficiency rating of all the Security Division branches.<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
